headline: European AI funding is strong, led by defence and physical AI and by growth rounds such as Helsing's $1.8bn. Finnish firms use AI at about twice the EU rate, and new Horizon Europe AI and robotics calls open on 17 November 2026.
outlook_reason: Capital, the Q3 2026 VC rebound, high Finnish AI adoption and a wave of Horizon Europe Apply AI calls all point up, while the AI Act delays reduce near-term compliance pressure.

signals.title: Saidot raises a funding round led by BackingMinds
signals.detail: The Helsinki AI governance platform closed a round led by BackingMinds, with Crowberry Capital and Ventic taking part. The amount was not disclosed. The money funds European growth, entry to the US and policy-as-code features.

signals.title: Helsing closes $1.8bn Series E at an $18bn valuation
signals.detail: Dragoneer led, with Lightspeed. This resolves the earlier open question: the round closed, and at $1.8bn it came in above the $1.2bn reported in May. One outlet gave euro figures (€1.6bn at €16bn), which look like a currency-conversion difference.

signals.title: AI Act Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) in force
signals.detail: It was published in the Official Journal on 2026-07-24. It postpones the high-risk obligations to December 2027 and August 2028 and adds bans on AI that generates non-consensual intimate imagery and child sexual abuse material, applying from 2026-12-02. Secondary sources disagree on some GPAI dates, so check the EUR-Lex text.

signals.title: October 2026 European AI seed and Series A rounds
signals.detail: Reported rounds include Machenta (London, robot learning from one demonstration, $40m seed), Duvo (London, $32m Series A), Enact Intelligence (Zurich, $30m pre-seed), Ravical (Ghent, $17m seed) and Tendos (Munich, €12m seed). The source is a mixed listing and no total was given, so this is only indicative. The date is approximate.

signals.title: Rotomate raises €2.1m pre-seed
signals.detail: The Finnish industrial machine-data AI company raised €2.1m. The source gives the date as 2026-06-10, outside the window for this update, but it is the first confirmed figure. Aalto links are still unconfirmed.

signals.title: STRGY AI raises €1m
signals.detail: The Helsinki AI strategy-execution platform raised a small angel and seed round.

signals.title: Aalto ranks third in Europe for university spinout funding (H1 2026)
signals.detail: Aalto ranked behind Oxford and Cambridge. It aims to raise spin-offs from historically 0–5 a year to as many as 25 a year by 2030. The Aalto Startup Center name is being retired. The date is the update date, because the article's publication date was not shown.
